5412-5531-6621-8345.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
5412-5531-6621-8345.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Repeat.

3682-5315-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one colored legendary creature or planeswalker.
Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3682-5315-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Amber enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana of any color among legendary creatures and planeswalkers you control.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Mox Amber, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mox Amber from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

751-3286-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
751-3286-4068.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4063-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
1981-2415-4063-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1981-2292-2415-3188.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2292-2415-3188.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2893-3470-5478-7886.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Beorn's Hospitality trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Beorn's Hospitality trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

372-2072-2781.manaNeeded: {6}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-2072-2781.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Felidar Guardian's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

6774-7009-7715.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
6774-7009-7715.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Loading Zone.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

215-3464-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Mona Lisa.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1029-6723-7010.description:
Activate Gran-Gran by tapping it, adding {1}.
Gran-Gran triggers, causing you to loot.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to untap Gran-Gran.
Repeat.

1292-3117-4908-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

444-2894-4451-7123.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
444-2894-4451-7123.description:
Attempt to draw a card. 
The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, instead causing you to discard Greater Mossdog. Then, the draw will be replaced by Greater Mossdog's dredge ability, causing you to mill cards and return Greater Mossdog from your graveyard to your hand.
Dredger's Insight's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Drogskol Reaver triggers, attempting to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

3129-4682-5140-6441.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
3129-4682-5140-6441.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Primal Vigor and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
3129-4682-5140-6441.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

5411-5795-6871-6879.description:
Cast Barkform Harvester by paying {3}.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Barkform Harvester.
When Barkform Harvester dies, Haru triggers, returning Barkform Harvester from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4943-6747-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
4943-6747-7070.description:
Activate Lancers en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Lancers en-Kor.
The Lancers en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Lancers en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Sami.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

1379-1978-2436.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Marwyn.
Repeat

1947-3327-4613-6602.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1947-3327-4613-6602.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Tromell.
Activate Dargo using Reckless Barbarian's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

5256-5972-6054.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
5256-5972-6054.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

549-1365-2099-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
549-1365-2099-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Sarcatog's second ability by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

457-1025-5382.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Stasis and Illustrious Wanderglyph trigger.
Resolve the Illustrious Wanderglyph trigger, creating a 1/1 Gnome artifact creature token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Gnome, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stasis trigger, causing you to pay {U}.
Repeat during each of your turns.
As long as Stasis is on the battlefield, players skip their untap steps.

2069-2452-5113-5220.description:
Cast Silumgar Butcher either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
When Silumgar Butcher enters the battlefield, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Silumgar Butcher dies, Mortuary triggers, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

uses.n: Gods' Eye, Gate to the Reikai

224-2098-4039-4474-5077.notablePrerequisites:
Scaretiller does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Scaretiller.
224-2098-4039-4474-5077.description:
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Vesuva from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Gods' Eye.
Put Vesuva into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Vesuva and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Scaretiller.
Resolve the Vesuva trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Repeat.

290-1651-2382-4840.description:
Activate Dreamstone Hedron's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Mimic Vat by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Myr Battlesphere with haste.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Myrs, untapping Mimic Vat.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Myrs, untapping Dreamstone Hedron.
Repeat.

851-4050-4385.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating two 1/1 Sliver creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Slivers, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1744-3096-3994-4710.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other Golems.
1744-3096-3994-4710.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, targeting Precursor Golem.
Precursor Golem triggers, creating a kicked copy of Rite of Replication targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Rite of Replication, creating five token copies of the Golem it is targeting.
If the Golem was Percursor Golem, the Percursor Golem tokens enter the battlefield, creating a total of ten 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3 for each other Rite of Replication.
Cast Slip Through Space by paying {U}, targeting any Golem.
The six Percursor Golems each trigger.
Resolve the first Percursor Golem trigger, creating a copy of Slip Through Space targeting every other Golem.
Repeat step 8 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the first Slip Through Space, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat step 10 until you draw from an empty library, causing you to win the game.

553-2109.notablePrerequisites:
Glacian does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least seven untapped artifacts.
553-2109.description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to gain seven life and put Approach of the Second Sun into your library seventh from the top.
Activate Glacian by tapping it and seven untapped artifacts you control, looking at the top seven cards of your library and putting Approach of the Second Sun into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.

32-1750-4861-5261.description:
Cast Temporal Trespass by paying {8}{U}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile Temporal Trespass.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Temporal Trespass into your graveyard from exile.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Temporal Trespass from your graveyard by paying {8}{U}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile Temporal Trespass.
Repeat from step 2.
